description_full: Cognyte Software Ltd., a software-driven technology company, focuses on investigative analytics solutions worldwide. The company offers network intelligence analytics, threat intelligence analytics, decision intelligence analytics, and operational intelligence analytics solutions. It also offers software products, including subscription or perpetual licenses and appliances that include software that is essential to the product's functionality; software services, such as support and cloud-based SaaS subscriptions; and professional services and others comprising installation and integration services, customer specific development work, resale of third-party hardware, and consulting and training services. In addition, the company provides customer support, professional, and integration services. It serves governments agencies, including national, regional, and local government agencies. Cognyte Software Ltd. was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Herzliya, Israel.

financial_summary: Cognyte Software Ltd. is a small-cap technology business with a $597M market cap on $400M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -6% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 4% against a 10% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests. Gross margins of 70% confirm genuine pricing power.
The business throws off $30M in free cash flow — roughly 7 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 68× is fortress-like.
Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 6.4% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.1× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
